name: Should I buy a fixer-upper or a move-in ready home?

mainEntity.name: Should I buy a fixer-upper or a move-in ready home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deciding between a fixer-upper and a move-in ready home depends on your budget, time, and renovation goals. Fixer-uppers often have a lower purchase price, allowing you to invest in custom improvements and potentially build equity. However, they require patience and a tolerance for construction. Move-in ready homes offer immediate occupancy and less stress but typically come at a higher initial cost and may not fully align with your design preferences. Consider your willingness to manage a renovation project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Fixer-uppers offer customization and potential equity but require time and patience. Move-in ready homes are convenient but pricier with less customization.
